success.description: A You utilize your superior education to confuse and bewilder your target into doing as you suggest. You influence the target

As above, plus the target draws an {Df} insanity from the deck. If it has either the Enigma or Trauma trait, the target suffers from its effects until the end of the current act. Otherwise, discard it

boon.description: The target loses 1 cunning die from his budget (if any)

bane.description: Add {Dm} to your next Social action against the target

chaosStar.description: You confuse even yourself. Place a recharge token on each of your currently recharging action cards

reckless.requirements: If you have Intuition on the check
reckless.name: Obfuscate
